Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton takes a closer look at the top stories for investors to watch on Tuesday, Sept. 1, including John Ternus's first day as Apple (AAPL) CEO, quarterly earnings from Dell (DELL) and Palo Alto Networks (PANW), and July's Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS).
for to watch Tuesday, September 1st. Today marks Tim Cook's final day as Apple CEO after 15 years at the helm.
John Turnis takes over on Tuesday with AI a front and center priority. He is inheriting an ambitious product pipeline that includes Apple's first foldable iPhone and a major Siri rollout expected in September.
More tech earnings ahead with Dell reporting second quarter results after the market's close. and I was looking for continue the momentum across both its AI and traditional enterprise businesses.
Investors will also be listening for how Dell is managing tight memory supplies and higher component costs.
And on the cybersecurity side, Palo Alto Networks also announcing quarter results after the bell. The company follows solid results from Crowdstrike and Okta, both point to healthy demand as companies spend more to protect their networks from AI related threats.
And turning to the labor market, we're getting the July job openings and labor turnover sur survey or jolts. The economist forecasting that number of available positions to ease slightly to 7.31 million.
